title: Normalised EMG of 6 trunk muscles (L/R averaged) during maximal extension exertion (semi-seated), males
condition: isometric maximal extension exertion, semi-seated dynamometer

quantity.name: normalised EMG at MVE
quantity.definition: maximal RMS (non-overlapping windows, 30-450 Hz band-pass) of the trial, divided by the maximum of that muscle over all trials in all directions (flex, ext, lateral, axial) for each subject; left and right averaged (no significant side difference)

source.authors: El Ouaaid Z, Shirazi-Adl A, Plamondon A, Lariviere C
source.sample: 12 healthy males (4 modelled); healthy male university students, no back pain history, in vivo

protocol.summary: Trunk dynamometer with three triaxial AMTI MC6-6-1000 force platforms on a steel frame stabilising feet, knees and pelvis (similar to Lariviere 2009); semi-seated position; 10-s maximal pushes against a harness (3 trials extension, 2 flexion, 2 per side lateral and axial); moments at L5-S1 recorded at 128 Hz. Harness-trunk contact: anterior-directed force at T8 in extension; force normal to sternum at T6 in flexion. 12 bilateral Delsys DE-2.3 surface electrodes, 1024 Hz.
how_to_simulate: Simulate the extension MVE as in msk_mvc_coupled.elouaaid2013.mve_moment_extension (semi-seated, harness load giving the measured L5-S1 moment).
Normalise each model muscle's active force by its maximum over simulated MVEs in all directions (or by PCSA x max stress).
Compare activation of LGPT (L1, 3 cm), ICPT (L3, 6 cm), MF (L5, 2 cm), RA, EO, IO with the means (agonists ~64-87%, antagonists ~9-24%).

subject_model.source: Methods 2.1 (mean of 12); per-subject body weights for 4 modelled subjects in Table 1 (68, 76, 68.3, 72.8 kg)

protocol.notes: Agonist values quoted in text; antagonist values digitised from Fig 3. Electrode sites per Methods 2.1 (De Foa 1989; McGill 1991). The paper's text writes 'ILPT' for the iliocostalis value (Fig 3 label ICPT).

data.site: longissimus, ~3 cm lateral to midline at L1 (left/right averaged)
iliocostalis, ~6 cm lateral to midline at L3 (left/right averaged)
multifidus, ~2 cm lateral to midline at L5 (left/right averaged)
rectus abdominis, ~3 cm lateral to midline above umbilicus (left/right averaged)
external oblique, ~10 cm lateral to midline above umbilicus, aligned with fibres (left/right averaged)
internal oblique, ~2 cm below and 7 cm medial to ASIS (left/right averaged)

extraction.uncertainty: text values exact; digitised ±1 %MVC (mean), ±1 %MVC (SD); digitised means corrected by -0.5% for outline bias found on the 6 text-reported bars
extraction.check_notes: Pixel digitisation at 250 dpi; the same procedure reproduced the six text-reported agonist means within +0.2..+0.7% and SDs within 0.5%, so antagonist values carry ~±1% uncertainty. Note text order 'IO, EO and RA reached 73.6, 87.0, 75.1' matches Fig 3 (RA~75, EO~87, IO~74).
